title: A Novel Approach to Clustering Shape Data Using Iteratively Weighted Vectors with k-Means
abstract: arXiv:2611.28880v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Topological data analysis provides a collection of methods for analyzing data with shape structure, including point clouds, graphs, and images. Recent advances in topological vectorization have enabled the embedding of shape data into Euclidean spaces, facilitating comparisons and machine learning tasks. Vector summaries that effectively capture topological structures are particularly useful for shape classification and unsupervised learning tasks such as clustering. We investigate the use of vectorized topological data for clustering through k-means, which partitions observations into a fixed number of groups by minimizing a squared-error loss function. By incorporating an element-wise weight-update step into the iterative k-means algorithm, we improve clustering performance on both simulated and real-world shape datasets. translated_title: 一种利用迭代加权向量结合k-均值对形状数据进行聚类的新方法
translated_abstract: 拓扑数据分析提供了一系列用于分析具有形状结构的数据（包括点云、图和图像）的方法。拓扑向量化领域的最新进展使得形状数据能够嵌入到欧几里得空间中，从而便于进行比较和机器学习任务。能够有效捕捉拓扑结构的向量摘要对于形状分类以及聚类等无监督学习任务尤为有用。我们研究了利用向量化拓扑数据通过k-means进行聚类的方法，该算法通过最小化平方误差损失函数将观测值划分为固定数量的组。通过在迭代k-means算法中引入逐元素的权重更新步骤，我们在模拟数据集和真实世界的形状数据集上都提升了聚类性能。我们证明了这些权重的估计可以归结为一个最小二乘问题，只需极少的额外计算量。
tldr: 该论文提出在迭代k-means算法中加入逐元素权重更新步骤以提升形状数据的聚类性能，并将权重估计归结为最小二乘问题，几乎不增加额外计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes incorporating an element-wise weight-update step into the iterative k-means algorithm to improve clustering performance on shape data, where weight estimation reduces to a least-squares problem requiring minimal additional computation.
